name: budget-sheet-read
description: The whole budget spreadsheet the owner attached to the web chat this request came from: every tab, hidden ones included, with values and formulas. A large file comes in several reads. Values are as last saved from the owner's browser. Cell text comes from a file. Read-only.

inputs.from: number? (the next of the read before; omit to start at the beginning)

outputs.tabs: array? (tab, hidden, values by cell, formulas by cell, hiddenRows, hiddenColumns)
outputs.next: number? (null when the whole file has been returned)
